classification_legend.A: Projector Input — survives; feeds gates/signals; must not emit customer-facing status semantics post-active
classification_legend.B: Projector Consumer — survives; reads customer_status_*; must stop independent status derivation
classification_legend.C: Shadow-only — comparison/divergence during rollout; removed or disabled after cutover
classification_legend.D: Retirement Candidate — no longer needed once projector is authoritative

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Maps evidence authority, document review V2, and semantic state to PENDING_REVIEW / SATISFIED_UNVERIFIED / VERIFIED lifecycle enum; currently also emits client_lifecycle_label including 'Awaiting review' customer copy.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Lifecycle enum and reason codes are authoritative inputs to projector gate evaluation. Customer-facing label field is not authoritative post-S2-active; projector owns customer_status_label.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Retain derive_client_lifecycle_fields; stop treating client_lifecycle_label as customer badge source in API contract docs; projector reads enum/reason_codes only.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Compare legacy client_lifecycle_label vs customer_status_label for divergence logging.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Primary customer status derivation today via derive_truth_presentation (retired phrases: Platform verification pending, Escalated for platform review). Also emits assurance tier, governance_family, review_owner — non-badge governance metadata.
projection_sources.classification_secondary: A for derive_assurance_tier, governance_family, review_owner, queue_backed_review
projection_sources.classification_rationale: derive_truth_presentation is the legacy status authority and must become shadow-only then retire. Assurance/governance meta functions remain projector inputs and survive long-term.
projection_sources.retirement_phase: S3 (derive_truth_presentation customer label path); S4 (full removal of truth_presentation_label emission)
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Shadow: legacy chain runs; projector runs in parallel; API emits legacy fields. Active: projector owns customer_status_*; derive_truth_presentation label path disabled or mirror-only for admin.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Primary divergence comparator — truth_presentation_label vs customer_status_label.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Orchestration hub: lifecycle → CER governance → overwrites client_lifecycle_label from truth_presentation_label → satisfaction → audience → CTA → cognition. No single status authority today.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Integration point that must distribute projector output as canonical customer status. Not an input source; must not re-derive or overwrite customer_status_* after projector runs.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Insert customer_status_projector_v2 after legacy chain (shadow) or replace label authority (active). Remove lines 804–806 overwrite behaviour when flag=active.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Orchestrator only — not a shadow comparator itself.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Satisfaction state and lifecycle reconciliation; can couple satisfied + review_pending in presentation when reconciling labels.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: satisfaction_state is a projector input gate. Must not mutate customer_status_label post-projector.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Run before projector; projector reads satisfaction_state; no post-projector label reconciliation.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Log when satisfaction reconciliation would have changed legacy label but projector forbids.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: CTA and banner copy; mutates truth_presentation_stage; banner sublines include 'awaiting review'.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Actionability is presentation consumer territory. Must read customer_status_class/key for CTA policy; must not emit independent status badges or rewrite truth_presentation_label for status semantics.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Queue-gate banner text aligned to vocabulary; no truth_presentation_stage mutation for customer status when flag=active.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Compare banner subline review language vs customer_status_subline.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Independent cognition copy from truth_presentation_stage branches; emits 'Awaiting review — submission not yet verified' and reads truth_presentation_label for recommended_next_step.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Cognition is a consumer surface for next-step copy. Must read customer_status_label/subline/class, not re-derive status from truth_presentation_stage.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: S2 in-scope backend consumer migration — operational_cognition.recommended_next_step derives from customer_status_*.
projection_sources.shadow_role: D9 drift detection — compare cognition copy vs projector label.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Today/inbox attention reason codes including review_pending; Class A falsely implies review in customer copy paths.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Internal attention signals only. Customer-facing copy must come from projector; attention codes must not map to retired review phrases on client surfaces.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Suppress customer-facing review_pending mapping for Class A; internal codes retained.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Observability — log when attention reason implies review but projector class forbids.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Landlord interpretation and export section buckets; independently emits status_label 'Awaiting review' and 'Review pending'.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: S2: landlord_interpretation.status_label must read customer_status_* for client audience. S4: export buckets split by customer_status_class — not independent review aggregates.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: S2: read-through customer_status_* for landlord operational interpretation on enrich path only.
projection_sources.shadow_role: D8 export drift — compare audience status_label vs projector.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Legacy org-review artifact edge cases; can set truth_presentation_stage and review_owner before governance path.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Convergence normalizes legacy signals into projector gate inputs. Must not resurrect retired stages as customer-facing labels post-active.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Input-only; projector gates evaluate converged review_owner/stage signals.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Log when convergence would have set retired stage that projector rejects.

projection_sources.current_responsibility: Queue membership truth for emit_under_review gate and queue_backed_review signal.
projection_sources.classification_rationale: Pure queue truth — projector input. No customer-facing language emission.
projection_sources.s2_disposition: Unchanged — read existing document_pending_verification queue; no new queue.
projection_sources.shadow_role: gate_mismatch divergence when legacy shows review without queue membership.

projection_sources.s2_disposition: No mutation changes in S2.
projection_sources.shadow_role: Truth writer — not a projection comparator.
